name: What is the typical process for a kitchen remodel with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a kitchen remodel with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our kitchen remodeling process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, lifestyle, and functional needs. Following this, we develop a comprehensive design concept, including CAD-supported layouts and material selections, ensuring every detail aligns with your expectations. Once the design is finalized and permits are secured, our experienced team manages the construction phase, providing a single point of coordination through installation and final walkthrough. This integrated design-build approach ensures seamless execution and clear communication throughout your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our kitchen remodel process involves consultation, comprehensive design with CAD layouts, permit coordination, construction, and a final walkthrough, all managed by our integrated design-build team.
